excludedCandidates.reason: First-online date and identifiers are verified for October 20, but the accessible primary record still does not expose sufficient study results for an evidence-grade summary; retained in the queue for primary review.

First-online date and identifiers are verified for October 20, but the primary PubMed record has no abstract and the official full-text route remains inaccessible; secondary numerical summaries were not used for publication.

VECARS-2 primary abstract was previously reviewed. The before-after observational study improved bag-mask ventilation process measures without demonstrating a patient-outcome benefit; it remains held rather than used as filler.

Post hoc WESTCOR-POC analysis found a modest length-of-stay reduction only when disposition followed the accelerated pathway recommendation; secondary/process evidence was judged below today's publication threshold.
SAVE-ICU is a large randomized ICU sedation trial but did not improve hospital mortality and has limited immediate ED practice implications; not selected for the selective daily brief.

Current AHA-led scientific statement on female-specific cardiovascular disease was identified, but its primary focus is life-course prevention and longitudinal management rather than acute ED diagnosis or treatment; not selected.

Randomized modified-versus-reverse Valsalva publication is indexed as a letter and the accessible primary record provides no abstract/results; insufficient primary evidence was available for an evidence-grade summary.
ESO 2026 blood-pressure stroke guideline was published in May 2026, outside the current recovery interval; not new by first-online date.
ESO 2026 aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage guideline was published in May 2026, outside the current recovery interval; not new by first-online date.
